podcast.description: The New York Times' daily news podcast — today's top story in 20 minutes.

stories.title: From Fortnite to robots: General Intuition raises $2.3B on bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
stories.description: General Intuition has raised $320 million to scale AI trained on millions of hours of gameplay, betting action data can help AI develop something closer to human intuition.

stories.title: Parker Conrad knows which employees are worth their AI spend and says Rippling can help you, too
stories.description: "There were employees doing things like, 'Claude is so helpful for me — it analyzes my calendar and my email and puts together a plan for me,'" he says. "That person was spending at a run rate of $30,000 a year for this…

stories.title: Google Finance gets a dedicated app for Android
stories.description: Users will be able to access their watchlists, real-time market data, live financial news, and Google's AI-powered "Key Moments" feature, which explains why stocks moved.

stories.title: Netris raises $15M Series A from a16z to help AI neoclouds go live faster
stories.description: Netris provides software that runs on network switches, and offers a platform that helps neocloud operators reduce the time it takes to go live.

stories.title: Feds deny Polestar authorization to sell cars in US from model year 2027
stories.description: Unlike with Volvo, there will be no authorization for Polestar to sell its cars here.

stories.title: Apple ratchets up prices, blames the cost of memory
stories.description: Some Macs are hundreds of dollars more expensive today than yesterday.

stories.title: Europe's heatwave shifts east as France raises health alert to highest level
stories.description: Temperatures in Germany could hit 40C in some areas while French officials say deaths linked to the heat are being seen among young people.

stories.title: Ryanair says it will reluctantly not charge parents to sit next to children
stories.description: The airline had typically charged adults a fee of £8 each way to sit with their young children.

stories.title: People flee as building collapses on Caracas outskirts
stories.description: The capital and its surrounding areas have seen some of the worst damage from the 7.2 and 7.5 quakes, which hit a minute apart.

stories.title: TikTok influencer charged with Dubai murder
stories.description: Influencer Brooke George, 23, from Kent, claims she acted in self defence in stabbing her partner.

stories.title: Supreme Court says U.S. can turn away asylum seekers at the border
stories.description: By a 6 to 3 vote, the high court ruled that that federal law allows the government to stop asylum seekers from physically setting foot in the United States, effectively keeping them from applying for asylum.

stories.title: Trump can begin deportations of Syrian, Haitian TPS holders, Supreme Court says
stories.description: Writing for the court majority, Justice Samuel Alito that under the TPS law, the president has unreviewable authority to end the program, without intervention from the courts.

stories.title: They fled war as child refugees, now they’re playing at World Cup 2026
stories.description: In a World Cup for everyone, as it has been dubbed by FIFA, players carry historic stories of war and displacement.

stories.title: Israel kills three in Lebanon as Rubio praises progress in Washington talks
stories.description: Lebanon’s state-run National News Agency reports three people killed after an Israeli attack on a car in Nabatieh.

stories.title: 'I thought I was going to die' - Venezuelans describe earthquake panic
stories.description: Buildings were flattened in the capital Caracas, where voices have been heard calling from the rubble.

stories.title: Lebanon Latest: Peace talks between Lebanon and Israel, people return south
stories.description: Al Jazeera’s Robert McBride brings you the latest from Beirut as people return to the south of Lebanon.

stories.title: Iran accuses NATO of ‘complicity’ in US war: What role did EU nations play?
stories.description: NATO boss tries to convince Trump that European allies were there for the US during war on Iran.

stories.title: Earthquake is devastating blow to Venezuela at time of uncertainty
stories.description: The twin quakes come less than six months after Venezuela's then-leader Nicolás Maduro was seized by US forces.

stories.title: Apple stock drops 5% on MacBook and iPad price hikes due to memory crunch
stories.description: Tim Cook said last week that Apple would hike prices due to surging memory and storage costs.

stories.description: “He also wants me to downsize and move.”

stories.description: Glyphosate, used in Roundup weedkiller, is the most commonly used weedkiller in agriculture, and it has long been linked to cancer claims.
